steps.en: Install the plugin in Claude Code
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 安装插件
steps.code: claude plugin marketplace add tanweai/pua · claude plugin install pua@pua-skills

steps.en: At every session start, inject persona, red lines and the methodology router into context
steps.zh: 每次会话启动，把人设、红线与方法论路由注入上下文

steps.en: Work as usual — or pull the trigger yourself
steps.zh: 照常干活，或自己动手触发

steps.en: Count consecutive command failures, escalate L0 to L4, force a methodology switch
steps.zh: 统计连续失败，逐级加压 L0→L4，强制切换方法论

steps.en: The red lines refuse "done" without evidence and "I can't" with avenues unexhausted
steps.zh: 红线拦下没证据的「完成」和没穷尽的「做不到」

value.en: The agent keeps going past its usual quit point and closes with evidence
value.zh: agent 越过惯常的放弃点继续排查，带着证据收工
